_readme.what: Playtest feedback — the DRAGONSLEEP playtest lamp, one verdict per checklist line.
_readme.fold_back: Whoever takes this (Cowork seat or code tab): broken and unclear lines become the fix list; too hard / too easy are tuning; notes are the tester's words, verbatim. Load this file back into the lamp to keep going.
_readme.round: FIVE (R5) — seeded by the code tab 2026-09-26 from Griz's round-four marks (playtest-ear-file-2026-09-25-round-four.json, saved 21:39Z). Lines that passed keep their verdict (notes marked R4:); lines that were broken, unclear, too hard, too easy or not tested are blank with round four's words and 're-test'. New: section 16 (the round-four fold and the 09-26 asks: E to talk, Heroism shown) and sections 17-21 (the dwarven expansion: the door, the highway, Deepholm's door, the smoke, the sidequests). Load this into the lamp (Load), mark, then Save ear-file.

items.claim: Winters: bring an errand back and he closes it as soon as you speak to him, then hands over the next one in the same breath (no picking WORK)

items.section: 16. Round five: the fold from the 09-25 round-four ear-file, and your 09-26 asks
items.claim: Mage Armor: in the field and in a fight, an ally in real armor can't be picked (ARMORED); robes still take it

items.section: 16. Round five: the fold from the 09-25 round-four ear-file, and your 09-26 asks
items.claim: E talks and chooses now (Z, Enter and Space still work); every on-screen hint says E

items.section: 16. Round five: the fold from the 09-25 round-four ear-file, and your 09-26 asks
items.claim: Heroism: Lymen's cast line names the number (+2 at CHA 15); a cyan +2 floats over the target at the start of each of its turns; the party panel shows +2 beside the name; a hit says "heroism takes 2"

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: After the chuul, the first time you walk into Silverton: Papa Urtusk walks up from off the screen, out of his door; the scales are lit; the journal pins THE ONE LAW

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: The Warrens' wet, past the mark: the water stair is dry (silt, a tide-line, the siphon left standing); a puddle in the corner that shivers; the warranted door at the foot cut through

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: Through the cut door: the top tier of the Burial. Four of them at a family's niches: CHALLENGE / VIVIAN KNOWS THEM (Vivian in the party) / TAKE A CUT / LEAVE

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: The checks show on screen: the skill, the DC, whose hand, the die tumbling and landing, the total, SUCCESS or NOT ENOUGH

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: The fight: Hask with a pry-bar, the wheelwright with a mallet and a lamp, two crewmen. Drop Hask and the wheelwright runs for the stair on his next turn (no XP for him)

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: Vivian's word (Persuasion 13): they drop the sack and go up the stair without a word

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: Take a cut (Intimidation 15): 200 sp, renown -1; Ingrith comes anyway and withholds the offer. Three long rests later they come back for the rest; beat them and the offer comes, without the escort

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: Ingrith Scalebeam comes along the tier with a lamp and two of the garrison: the ledger, her name, the trade, the highway as the argument, the offer, the warrant for Audun's shield. Her two bar the cut door; the dwarves' stair at the far end opens

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: The Burial: seven families fanning down four tiers to the king's chamber; every niche reads (a name, a season, the lamp they fell at); rows stop short where a family did. The chamber: one kept lamp that glows in the dark, a clean slab, nobody on it

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: Put the sack back on the pried niches (the names come back); Audun's shield comes off his bones on the warrant and offers itself to Lymen

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: Take something without a warrant (Asmund's hammer, or the shield before Ingrith): Ketil stops you at the vault door ("Empty your packs"), takes it back to the dead, renown -1 each. No fight

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: The Door-Shield: +2 shield, and now and then a miss off Lymen makes the shield flare; light goes out from it and comes down on everyone; the party shines silver; "The Door-Shield protects the party." Did you ever see it happen?

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: Up the dwarves' stair into SOLSKAFT: the Sunshaft (noon down the old main shaft, dust turning in the light), the race down the east wall, footbridges to the kitchens and barracks, the clan hall (the empty high seat, the oath-stone, the hero-wall), the shrine of the Triad

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: Down to the vault hall: Pyro turns and gives you his one line; Ketil beside him. The tollhouse (the scales under a cloth, the tariff board, Ingrith at her ledger, the quartermaster's stores); the falls-works (the stamp-mill wheel turning, the cistern, the bricked cut from the Water Burning)

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: The muster yard: troopers drilling, Brann and Hedda, a free cot (long rest, save)

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: Out the vault door onto Fountain Street, and back in through it (it opens for you now). Vera and a Shaft Rows hand have something to say about it

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: The works below: the Copperbottom smith (dwarven steel, splint, nothing magic), the cold smelters, the cupel-hearth, the assay house, the sealed mint, the empty treasury, the boarded trade hall, and the highway's gate (shut for now)

items.section: 17. The dwarven expansion, part one: the door opens (cap still 5)
items.claim: Music: a new hall theme in Solskaft, and a slow one in the Burial

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: The cap: after the chuul, levels 6 to 9 open (14,000 / 23,000 / 34,000 / 48,000 XP). Before the chuul the game stays capped at 5

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Barley 6 STR, 7 quicker off the mark, 8 CON (HP catches up), 9 Indomitable ("Barley shakes it off" on a failed save, once a day)

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Aurdin 6 Acid Splash + Potent Cantrip, 7 Ice Storm and Greater Invisibility (4th-level slots), 8 INT and Stoneskin, 9 Cone of Cold and Hold Monster (5th)

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Vivian 6 Expertise in Stealth and Deception, 7 Evasion, 8 DEX, 9 Supreme Sneak (hidden longer); Sneak Attack 4d6 at 7, 5d6 at 9. Her skills now grow when DEX does

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Lymen 6 Aura of Protection (the party adds his CHA to saves while he stands; a small glint on everyone), 7 Aura of Devotion, 8 STR/CHA, 9 Revivify (needs a diamond) and Daylight

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: The gate in the works: the season musters, Brann and Hedda walk with you (unless the ledger doubts you), Ingrith's ledger-lamp, the gate goes up

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Guests: Brann (axe) and Hedda (hammer and shield) fight behind the four on their own, with their own HP bars; knocked out, they sit out until the next lamp's rest

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: On the road: the dark, and the ledger-lamp's wider light; whole seals glow white along the walls, cut ones red; LAMP 1 · DAY 1 in the corner

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Leg one: goblins, hobgoblins (worse with a friend beside them), worgs, bugbears (hard on the first round). The cut seal (red) opens on the goblins' camp: a bugbear chief, a hobgoblin sergeant and the rest. The truesilver seam in the cut edge

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: First Lamp: Ulf Silversands and his troopers; the day ends, you rest, a milestone, THE SECOND DAY

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: The Copperbottom smith re-hafts Barley's flail with the truesilver: THE WINNOWER (+2, and a critical hit knocks the target flat)

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Leg two: the great cavern, the chasm either side. The causeway passes under a stalactite; with the ledger-lamp a Perception check shows it's a roper (fight it, or go round by the rim-path). Gricks, darkmantles, a gibbering mouther (the gibbering stuns, the spit blinds), a gelatinous cube you can see through

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: A new breach in the south wall (red, never sealed): a bulette comes up through the road and leaps on the party

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Second Lamp: dark two seasons, you sleep there anyway; the roster on the slates; the black pudding in the drainage cut below (optional; it splits under slashing)

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Leg three: duergar (they swell huge, or vanish), grimlocks, drow with poisoned bolts; a xorn eats its way out of the wall

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Third Lamp, taken: the raid (a blade-captain, a spell-weaver throwing lightning and holds, five drow). GO IN, or CREEP UP FIRST (a group Stealth check: win it and the first round is yours). Win: Brann lights the lamp, the escorts stay to hold it, a big milestone, the road is held

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: The captain in the barrack-cut: the Greyseam knife (+2; a sneak attack with it poisons). Hedda has a line about it

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Held lamps are warp points: the lamp-tower's menu (rest, back up to Solskaft, on to another held lamp); the gate's menu the same way down

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Past Third Lamp: Deepholm's road (the next part)

items.section: 18. The dwarven expansion, part two: the highway (cap 9)
items.claim: Music: a new theme for the road

items.section: 19. The dwarven expansion, part three: Deepholm's door and the road's people
items.claim: Past Third Lamp the made road begins: dressed stone, the door the height of three men with a city's glow under it, Dagny at the toll-grille, the tariff in a live coin, a bench

items.section: 19. The dwarven expansion, part three: Deepholm's door and the road's people
items.claim: Torvald comes up the road from the door, in a hurry, and offers to heal. LET HIM GO / ASK HIM / HOLD HIM

items.section: 19. The dwarven expansion, part three: Deepholm's door and the road's people
items.claim: ASK HIM is a menu of checks, each once, each with a line saying what you're watching for: Insight 13, Religion 12, Medicine 14, then Persuasion 15 once any has worked (the sentence: the dwarves have been keeping secrets from the Druids that endanger the world), and Vivian's Sleight of Hand 15 (the curl of copper, warm)

items.section: 19. The dwarven expansion, part three: Deepholm's door and the road's people
items.claim: He heals when he goes (HP full, poison and paralysis cured, no slots); caught lifting the paper, he goes at once without healing

items.section: 19. The dwarven expansion, part three: Deepholm's door and the road's people
items.claim: HOLD HIM: a fight with Spirit Guardians, a Hold, Sanctuary when he's bloodied. At half HP he yields: LET HIM GO, or FINISH IT (his pack: the scraping, a kit, a holy symbol, 40 sp)

items.section: 19. The dwarven expansion, part three: Deepholm's door and the road's people
items.claim: The next rest of any kind after him (a tent, a lamp, the cot, an inn): the sect's two blades. WHO HAD THE WATCH? (their Stealth against the watcher's Perception; miss them and they get the first round, and their first hits are criticals)

items.section: 19. The dwarven expansion, part three: Deepholm's door and the road's people
items.claim: Their question: HE WENT UP (the truth, if he did) / HE WENT DOWN (Deception 15) / NOTHING TO SAY (if you carry what he carried: give it or fight; if not, they go and circle back once) / ASK THEM (Religion 12, Insight 14, Intimidation 16) / FIGHT (the hardest fight in the expansion, to the death)

items.section: 19. The dwarven expansion, part three: Deepholm's door and the road's people
items.claim: Try the door: Dagny's popup, her face in it, "Deepholm. Not tonight." Dagny sells one thing: a diamond (for Revivify)

items.section: 19. The dwarven expansion, part three: Deepholm's door and the road's people
items.claim: The consult: back up the lamps, Pyro gives his word ("I didn't say I'd like the answer"), Ingrith joins as a guest who heals; at the door she goes through and you don't; Dagny hands over the SUNSHAFT STAFF for Aurdin (+2, +1 spell DC, and its light shows hidden things in every fight)

items.section: 19. The dwarven expansion, part three: Deepholm's door and the road's people
items.claim: The credits: BEHIND THE FOUNTAINS, and one line before "Thanks for playing" that your choices wrote (the cleric's fate). THE ROAD IS HELD; CONTINUE wakes you in Solskaft

items.section: 19. The dwarven expansion, part three: Deepholm's door and the road's people
items.claim: Levels by the end: about 6 at First Lamp, 8 at Third Lamp, 9 at the door

items.section: 20. The dwarven expansion, part four: the smoke
items.claim: After the chuul, Tam Vere on vice row offers the couch and the good leaf (5 sp), or the common pipe (a short rest in town)

items.section: 20. The dwarven expansion, part four: the smoke
items.claim: The couch: the den in 8-bit (the party laid out on the couch, the lamp, the racks), smoke rising from the pipe and thickening, grey coming down the screen from the top

items.section: 20. The dwarven expansion, part four: the smoke
items.claim: Then twenty seconds with no words, drawn at full resolution: a castle on a headland, a sun-disc over its gate; a storm in off the sea, the light dropping by thirds, lightning (the frame bends with each strike); a tower struck, its top falling, the disc going dark

items.section: 20. The dwarven expansion, part four: the smoke
items.claim: The clouds close over everything. Low in the dark, a copper spire rises out of the bottom of the frame, up through the cloud

items.section: 20. The dwarven expansion, part four: the smoke
items.claim: It pierces the cloud; the cloud tears outward from that point; plain daylight, the castle standing with its broken tower, the disc lit. A hold, and back to the couch; the party gets up; no one says anything

items.section: 20. The dwarven expansion, part four: the smoke
items.claim: Sound: wind, thunder with the strikes, a bright ring when it pierces, and the title theme as you wake

items.section: 20. The dwarven expansion, part four: the smoke
items.claim: Tam's line after, once and for good: "Most come to forget. You came out with something." After you've met the cleric on the road, she mentions a dwarf on her couch who didn't sleep

items.section: 20. The dwarven expansion, part four: the smoke
items.claim: The couch again: the dream plays again, and holding E wakes you early

items.section: 20. The dwarven expansion, part four: the smoke
items.claim: Does it land? (It's meant to stay unexplained in the game.)

items.section: 21. The dwarven expansion, part five: the sidequests
items.claim: Put it back: return the crew's sack to the pried niches (the names come back), and the next fight with Brann beside you he says whose they were. Or sell it to Vera for 80 sp, and a trooper at First Lamp says it to your face

items.section: 21. The dwarven expansion, part five: the sidequests
items.claim: Brann's father's axe: after the raid, under the drow's leavings at Third Lamp. Give it to him (he holds the lamp with it; later he's to stand Pyro's door) or keep it (+1, and Pyro's line goes cold). Walking without the escort, you can carry it up to him in the yard

items.section: 21. The dwarven expansion, part five: the sidequests
items.claim: The heir in the Stacks: Aldwin tells you of Wenna, who says she was Asmund's wife; Old Hob at the Warrens camp knows a face that never aged; Signy the rope-maker in the Shaft Rows; Ingrith and the ledger; the rite at Asmund's wedge (his hammer, lawfully, and renown)

items.section: 21. The dwarven expansion, part five: the sidequests
items.claim: The standard weights: Ingrith lends them; at the Weigh-House board, EXPOSE Hessle (renown +2; his daughter on the street), WARN him (a true word about what Kessler is holding), or SELL it to Falstaff (150 sp)

items.section: 21. The dwarven expansion, part five: the sidequests
items.claim: Second Lamp's dark: at the dead tower, read the slates (Investigation 12), learn why it's dark (Religion 12), and relight it with the ledger-lamp (the debt is yours; the credits remember). Sleeping there while it's dark leaves everyone a hit die short

items.section: 21. The dwarven expansion, part five: the sidequests
items.claim: The wheelwright, at Brennan's forge: to Ingrith (a lift appears in the Sunshaft, top and bottom), to the ledger (renown +1), or, if Vivian talked the crew off, let him hide (a trooper at First Lamp notices later). Pyro has a word about it either way

items.section: 21. The dwarven expansion, part five: the sidequests
items.claim: What they took down: Ingrith needs the count; Androit won't sell; Idony copies one page if you bring her the dwarves' answer ("by the assay, never by the story"); Ingrith goes down with a number (and says so at the door)

items.section: 21. The dwarven expansion, part five: the sidequests
items.claim: The keeper's water: Ragna reverses the siphon if you hold the drained stair (a night crew comes for it); the stair floods again, the keeper stands up in it once, and the stair's text changes

items.section: 21. The dwarven expansion, part five: the sidequests
items.claim: The tariff board: at Deepholm's door, copy the last lines; Mical says the Coldridge caravan was never lost; Marko's son Tobin decides to stay

items.section: 21. The dwarven expansion, part five: the sidequests
items.claim: The curl of copper (if you have it): Winters pays 500 sp and asks nothing; Lucia takes it for nothing, and antitoxin is at cost at Mama's from then on

items.section: 21. The dwarven expansion, part five: the sidequests
items.claim: The journal has an entry for most of these, and the pin shows the way
